summary: Allen's public record centers the conflict on October 7, his Kibbutz K'far Aza visit, and his Jewish Caucus Chair role, framing Palestinian suffering alongside antisemitism and Islamophobia. In 2019 he backed the California Democratic Party's deletion of anti-Israel language—right of return, Golan Heights—from party resolutions, and in September 2025 voted Aye on AB 715, the antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight bill. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed.
